items.headline: Gale Watch issued October 15 at 6:50PM EDT until October 19 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and
seas 8 to 13 ft possible.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from NC VA border to Currituck Beach
Light NC out 20 NM, Waters from Cape Charles Light to Virginia
-North Carolina Border from 20 to 60 NM and Waters from NC VA
border to Currituck Beach Light NC from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From Saturday morning through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
